title: Usage
description: Metered events and the server's aggregates.
recordHint: One event for a customer and metric.
batchHint: A JSON array of events, each with customerId, metric and quantity; unit, occurredAt and resourceRef are optional.
emptyHint: Record an event or paste a batch.
batchInvalid: Event {{index}} needs customerId, metric and quantity.
notArray: Paste a JSON array of events.
quantityHint: A decimal number, for example 120 or 1.5.
aggregateHint: Totals per metric for one customer over a period.
